In this petition, the petitioner seeks following reliefs:
"To quash the entire proceedings in C.C.No.55044/2020 arising in Cr.No.167/2020 for offences punishable under section 498A, 323, 504 of IPC and sections 3, 4 of the D.P.Act, of Ashoknagar P.S., Bengaluru, pending on the file in the ends of justice of the 29th ACMM, now at ACJM, Mayohall, Bengaluru."
2.

After arguing the matter for sometime, learned counsel for petitioner submits that the petition may be NC: 2025:KHC:19551 HC-KAR disposed of as withdrawn reserving liberty in favour of the petitioner to seek discharge before the trial Court in CC.No.55044/2020.
3. The submission is placed on record.
